verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single product-page line saying Vanta "automates reminders and workflows to regularly assess" risk, which implies recurring workflows within the risk module. Continuous monitoring and automated tests run on Vanta's own cadence, so they are not user-scheduled jobs and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduling (cron/cadence settings) for general jobs or workflows, scheduling available via API/MCP for AI agents, coverage beyond risk reviews, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
